newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Dah Bang in management reshuffle.
newsitem.headline: HK's Dah Bang in management reshuffle.

text.p: Dah Bang (Holdings) Ltd said on Thursday Pang Tak Chung was appointed chairman and managing director of the company with effect from September 18, following completion of his purchase of a controlling stake in Dah Bang.
Dong Fangcheng was named deputy chairman and Robert Keith Davies executive director the same day, the statement said.

Earlier this week Golik Investments Ltd, controlled by Pang, agreed to buy 57.86 percent of Dah Bang's issued share capital and 72.49 percent of total warrants outstanding from its chairman Chen Da Yun and other directors for HK$107.77 million in cash.
